description: Drafts a 30-60-90 day plan skeleton for one job posting: what to learn in the first 30 days (the stakeholders and systems the posting names, a delivery health check), quick wins by day 60 tied to the problems the posting states, and day 90 goals written as targets for the person to set. Each item names the posting requirement it answers and, where one fits, the person's own resume line. Fixed rules, no model. Contact details are removed before the check; the resume and the posting are not stored. Requires sign-in with a PM Career Desk account that has an Interview Coach Pass.

job_posting.description: The full text of the job posting, as the person gave it, at least 15 words; the plan is built from its requirements.
job_posting.title: Job Posting

resume_text.description: The resume as plain text, copied in full from what the person pasted or from the text of the file they attached. At least the summary and the experience section.
resume_text.title: Resume Text

role.description: Optional. The target role, for example program manager or technical program manager.
role.title: Role

title: Draft a 30-60-90 day plan
